title: GreenGateway Standalone Backup Manifest
description: The manifest that is the first entry, gateway-backup.json, of every standalone backup archive ggctl backup create writes (docs/standalone-backup.md). It records the program and SQLite versions that wrote the archive, the archive container version, the logical inventory of every store of the standalone state-directory layout, one entry per physical database with its exact length, SHA-256 and SQLite description (header versions, pages, a schema digest and the rows of each table), the configuration revision ledger's state when it is included, and the counts all of these imply. The document is closed: a member this version does not define, a duplicate member, a missing member or a value outside its grammar makes it unreadable, and so does any inconsistency between the inventory, the entries and the counts; a reader that does not implement this exact apiVersion and kind treats the backup as incompatible. The digests are integrity evidence, not authenticity: whoever can write an archive can write a consistent one. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: the reader in the gateway-config crate is authoritative.

apiVersion.description: Exact document version. No other version, prefix, or spelling is accepted.

archive.description: The archive container: GreenGateway's framed format, version 1.

source.description: What was backed up: a standalone state directory, held under its lock. PostgreSQL and cluster state is never backed up this way.

createdBy.description: The program, and its version, that wrote the archive.

createdAtMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as the writer stamped it.

sqliteVersion.description: The SQLite library version that took the snapshots.

stores.description: The logical inventory: every store of the state-directory layout once, in the layout's order. An included store names the entry that holds it: its own file, or for a store whose file was another name for an earlier store's file, that store's entry.

entries.description: The archive's entries after the manifest, in archive order: one per physical database, named after the file of the first store it holds.

ledger.description: Present exactly when the configuration revision ledger is included: its state as the ledger's full verification reported it.

active.description: The revision a gateway last activated; null until one has.

bundleApiVersion.description: The document version of the desired revision's bundle.

counts.description: What the inventory and entries imply: stores in the layout and included, database entries, their bytes, tables and rows.

bytes.description: The entry's exact length: the database's page size times its pages.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the entry's exact bytes.

database.description: The database as SQLite describes it. Every entry is in rollback-journal mode and passed PRAGMA integrity_check when it was written.

applicationId.description: PRAGMA application_id: 1195855943 (GGLG) for the ledger, 0 for the gateway's stores.

userVersion.description: PRAGMA user_version: the ledger's format version, 0 for the gateway's stores.

schemaSha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the compact JSON array of every sqlite_schema row with SQL, as [type, name, tbl_name, sql] sorted: the store's schema version as the gateway's migrations leave it.

tables.description: Every table outside SQLite's own, sorted by name, with its row count.
